documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Khaitan (India) reported significant revenue growth for FY2026, driven primarily by its electrical goods segment, though profit decreased slightly due to rising costs amid global geopolitical tensions. The company's sugar division operations remain suspended due to high working capital requirements and input costs, with management anticipating a future turnaround when conditions permit. The agriculture division continues to generate small, stable revenues without exceptional increases. Furthermore, management remains focused on expanding the electrical division's market share through broader geographical reach, diverse product mixes, and effective online marketing platforms. Management reported a strong financial turnaround for the fiscal year 2024-25, achieving revenue of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that the company will be able to maintain growth and increase profitability over a period of time.
guidance.quote: Your directors are hopeful that company would be able to maintain the growth and profitability would also increase over period of time.

guidance.claim: The company expects GDP to grow in the range of 6.3% to 6.8% in the financial year 2025-26.
guidance.quote: Despite this, the overall outlook remains positive, with GDP expected to grow in the range of 6.3%–6.8% in the financial year 2025–26, supported by strong fundamentals and ongoing reforms.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for electrical division products is increasing due to quality and brand value.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for the product is increasing due to quality and brand value.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand for energy-efficient and technologically advanced products has continued to expand substantially.
demand_outlook.quote: The rising domestic demand for energy-efficient and technologically advanced products has further fuelled industry expansion.

demand_outlook.claim: The electrical goods market is increasing substantially due to continued demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Further. Company is also increasing the product mix to grab larger share of electrical goods market, which is increasing substantially due to continued demand.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company incorporated two subsidiaries during the year for strategic planning purposes.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has incorporated two subsidiaries during the year for the purpose of the strategic planning.

capex_expansion.claim: In relation to the electrical division, the company is looking for expansion in all geographical areas through its network.
capex_expansion.quote: In relation to the electrical division, Company has substantially increased the operation and is looking for expansion in all geographical area through its network.

margins_costs.claim: Profit before tax and profit after tax slightly decreased compared to the previous financial year due to increased expenses amid global geo-political conditions.
margins_costs.quote: The turnover of the company has increased significantly, however, due to increase in cost amid global geo-Political condition, the expenses of the Company has increased resulting into slight decrease in profit of the company.

margins_costs.claim: Fixed costs saw only a marginal increase after the company breached the breakeven threshold.
margins_costs.quote: Further, as company has breached the threshold of breakeven, the fixed cost has marginal increase resulting into better profitability.

margins_costs.claim: No income tax is applicable for the year due to accumulated losses.
margins_costs.quote: Further, due to accumulated losses, no income tax is applicable.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not propose to transfer any amount to reserves during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: Company does not propose to transfer any amount to the reserve during the year.

capital_allocation.claim: The directors decided to withhold the dividend during the financial year to conserve resources and improve liquidity.
capital_allocation.quote: With a view to conserve resources, your directors have decided to withhold the dividend during the financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Directors decided to withhold dividend for the financial year to conserve resources, improve liquidity, and fund expansion activities.
capital_allocation.quote: With a view to conserve resources, your directors have decided to withhold the dividend during the financial year. This will conserve the resources and improve liquidity and cater to the fund for the expansion activity of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company converted a loan of Rs. 3 crores into equity shares of Eskay Properties Development Private Limited during the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year 2024-25, Company has converted loan of Rs. 3 Crores, resulting into allotment of 1,27,659 shares by Eskay Properties Development Private Limited as per the valuation report obtained.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operation of the Sugar Division has been suspended owing to factors of huge working capital requirement and very huge input cost.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operation of the Sugar Division has been suspended owing to factor of the huge working capital requirement and very huge input cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: The sugar division's operations remain suspended due to huge working capital requirements and very high input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operation of the Sugar Division has been suspended owing to factor of the huge working capital requirement and very huge input cost, Company believes that it may expect some turnaround in future.

risks_headwinds.claim: The sugar business remains vulnerable to climatic fluctuations, pests, and diseases affecting sugarcane quality.
risks_headwinds.quote: The sugar business remains highly dependent on the quality and availability of sugarcane, which is vulnerable to climatic fluctuations, pests, and diseases.

risks_headwinds.claim: The production activities of the sugar mill could not be resumed during the current year because of un-remunerative selling prices and high cost of production.
risks_headwinds.quote: The production activities could not be resumed during the current year because of un-remunerative selling prices and high cost of production.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to access more markets through various online market platforms for product marketing.
management_commitments.quote: Also, the Company is planning to have access to more markets through various online market platforms for the marketing of its product.

management_commitments.claim: The management is of the view that as soon as the requirement of working capital needed for running the operations is arranged the operation shall be resumed.
management_commitments.quote: The management is of the view that as soon as the requirement of working capital needed for running the operations is arranged the operation shall be resumed.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
